Example reports

Source: vignettes/articles/example_report.Rmd
example_report.Rmd

Two reports from render_report(), both run against the Fake NHS Trust synthetic dataset read through its fakehospdata package, leaving out its answers schema (the mess log and truth tables are the dataset’s answer key, not part of the trust’s warehouse). The sampled report profiles large tables on a sample of their rows, which is how a big warehouse is usually run. The full report profiles every row of every table, so its distinct counts and uniqueness are exact. They are regenerated by the example-reports workflow on the repository’s Actions tab, run by hand.

Report Dataset Sampling threshold Tables Tables sampled Columns Rows in total Phases 2 and 3 Run time Rendered
sampled full set 1,000,000 rows 45 7 518 54,368,976 not computed (sampled run) 22 s 2026-10-25 10:55 UTC
full full set none 45 0 518 54,368,976 90 foreign key candidates 28 s 2026-10-25 10:56 UTC

Full report

To make one for your own database:

library(DBinventory)
inventory_run("Driver={ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server};Server=...;Database=...;Trusted_Connection=yes;",
              organisation = "Your NHS Trust", store = "dw_inventory.sqlite", report = "dw_inventory.html")
